title: JITAtlas: Checking Lifetime and Protection Obligations in Compiler Rewrites
abstract: arXiv:2611.23715v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compiler rewrites can preserve returned values while violating object lifetime or ownership. Such failures arise when a rewrite changes when an object remains live, whether a borrowed pointer stays supported, or what ownership reaches the caller. We present JITAtlas, a source-level checker that reconstructs reference and target computations from optimizer code and checks valid uses, continuous borrow support, and caller-visible ownership. On a 58-input benchmark constructed and labeled independently of JITAtlas output, JITAtlas detects all 29 defects and reports none of 29 safe inputs; PyRefcon detects 20 defects and CpyChecker 18. Across three CPython snapshots, JITAtlas extracts 3,332 rewrite alternatives, retains 801 under recovered receiving contexts, and reports 194 violations. Manual review confirms 92 reports, giving 47.42% precision. End-to-end analysis takes 35.56-42.31 s per snapshot. JITAtlas further identifies 15 new bugs a

translated_title: JITAtlas：检查编译器重写中的生命周期与保护义务
translated_abstract: 编译器重写可能在保留返回值的同时违反对象生命周期或所有权。当重写改变了对象保持存活的时间、借用的指针是否持续受支持、或到达调用者的所有权内容时，就会出现这类故障。我们提出了JITAtlas，一个源码级检查器，它从优化器代码中重建引用与目标计算，并检查有效使用、持续的借用支持以及调用者可见的所有权。在一个独立于JITAtlas输出构建和标注的包含58个输入的基准测试上，JITAtlas检测出全部29个缺陷，且未对29个安全输入产生任何误报；相比之下，PyRefcon检测出20个缺陷，CpyChecker检测出18个。在三个CPython快照上，JITAtlas提取了3,332个重写替代方案，在恢复的接收上下文下保留了801个，并报告了194处违规。人工审查确认了92份报告，精确率为47.42%。每个快照的端到端分析耗时35.56–42.31秒。JITAtlas还进一步发现了15个新漏洞（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: JITAtlas是一个源码级检查器，通过从编译器优化器代码中重建引用与目标计算，检测编译器重写中违反对象生命周期、借用支持和调用者可见所有权的缺陷，在独立标注的基准上检出全部29个缺陷且无误报，并在CPython中发现15个新漏洞。
en_tdlr: JITAtlas is a source-level checker that reconstructs reference and target computations from optimizer code to detect compiler rewrites violating object lifetime, borrow support, or caller-visible ownership, detecting all 29 defects with no false positives on an independently labeled benchmark and uncovering 15 new bugs in CPython.
